blocks.text:
## Export formats today

I read the code instead of timing it, because the timing script could not find its sample file. So the speeds below are **estimates** from the code, not measurements.

| Format | Works today | Speed (estimate) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `srt` | yes | instant | plain text, one file per clip |
| `vtt` | yes | instant | same as srt, web style |
| `burn` | not yet | slow (about 1 min per clip) | this is step 4.3 |

### What I suggest

1. Keep `srt` and `vtt` as they are.
2. Build `burn` next, with the vertical cut first.
3. Time all three on the real sample clips once `burn` exists.

See the plan in `docs/plan/BOARD.md` for where this fits. A very long line without spaces must not break the layout: `src/captions/export-with-a-very-long-file-name-that-keeps-going-and-going-and-going.mjs`.
Step 4.3 is ready to build. Two choices from you first.

blocks.recap: Both styles work with the export fix. The word-by-word style takes about twice as long to export.
